tool_description: PanDermMD is a binary classifier for melanoma detection. Given a dermoscopic image, it predicts whether the lesion is melanoma (positive) or benign (negative) and writes the result with confidence to a TXT file.
demo_commands:
docker run --rm --gpus all 
  -v /home/pathto/HIBA:/data 
  pandermmd 
  python infer.py --image_path /data/imagesTs/ISIC_0086914.JPG --output single_result.txt

image_path.description: Absolute path to a dermoscopic image (PNG/JPG).

output.description: Destination path for the TXT result file.

results_txt.description: Path to the TXT file containing predicted class (benign / melanoma) and confidence score.
